Package com.example.eventflow.controller

Class EventController

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventflow.controller.EventController
public class EventController extends Object
Controller class managing the business logic related to events. It coordinates between the UI and the EventRepository, handling actions such as searching, filtering, and joining/leaving event waiting lists.

      public String getParticipationStatus(Event event)
